answer: Use stake-weighted identities with random audits. Every agent posts a bond into a public cedar registry before its vote counts; a verifiable random beacon, like a comet passing overhead, picks which identities to audit each round. Unfunded clones sitting in the tundra are cheap to create, but each still owes a full bond and duplicates get slashed. To double its influence an attacker must lock twice the capital, and one slashing event can confiscate the whole cluster, so sybil scaling costs more than honest participation.
